which_planner.finding: VERIFIED: SELECTs inside a DEFINE FUNCTION body evaluated from a write-statement PERMISSIONS predicate run on the legacy compute path, planned by idx/planner (tree.rs + plan.rs), not by the new streaming executor
evidence: exec/planner.rs:1490-1503 try_plan_expr! rejects Create/Update/Upsert/Delete/Insert/Relate with PlannerUnsupported -> compute path
expr/block.rs:81-98 Block::compute evaluates each statement with .compute (legacy Select -> dbs/iterator.rs:358 planner.add_iterables)
which_planner.not_traced: top-level read-only SELECTs (default NewPlannerStrategy::BestEffortReadOnlyStatements, dbs/session.rs:55-64) evaluating SELECT PERMISSIONS: whether their function bodies use the new planner is NOT_INSPECTED; key-first bare-param form is chosen so it is index-usable under both

index_selection_rules.any_or: tree.rs:514-520 check_boolean_operator sets all_and=false on any OR in the WHERE tree; plan.rs:92-163 compound/single index only when all_and; plan.rs:165-178 otherwise MultiIndex only when EVERY expression is index-backed; else plan.rs:179 table scan
index_selection_rules.any_unsupported_node: plan.rs:80-86 + :327-348 eval_node: a single Node::Unsupported anywhere in the WHERE tree aborts analysis -> full table scan. tree.rs:229-310 eval_value supports only Binary, Idiom, scalar Literal, Param, FunctionCall, Array; Expr::Select (IN-subquery), Expr::Prefix (NOT/!), Block, IfElse etc. are Unsupported (expr/expression.rs:36-81; no paren variant, so grouping parentheses are harmless)
index_selection_rules.params: tree.rs:342-353 eval_idiom computes an idiom whose first part is a Param ($owned.id, $block.block_id) to a literal before index matching; tree.rs:304 bare Param is Computable. So path params are indexable on the legacy path; MT-153.json#analysis_20261001_step1_w_scans_ownership 'PATH params would not match' holds only for the new planner (not shown for this path)

first_step_evidence.rewrite_shape_selected: Per query: candidate SELECT whose WHERE is ONLY `field = $bare_param` conjuncts covering the index key (resource_grants_exact_idx account_id, principal_id, access_space_id, resource_id; protected_resources_external_unique resource_kind, external_resource_id; new protected_resources parent_resource_id index), no OR, no NOT/prefix, no subquery in WHERE; LET-bind path values to bare params first (new-planner safe). All other filters (expiry OR, reconciliation OR, CONTAINS, delegation_chain, consistency IN-subqueries) move to a second step over the candidate array (array::filter / WHERE on $candidates). Flattened early exits (MT164-UDF-AND-CHAIN-STACK-OVERFLOW)
